_documentation: Copy this file to scripts/.blocklist.json (which is gitignored) and fill in your specific values. The redact-check.py scanner will load it at runtime and add these to the exact-match secret detection. Without it, the scanner falls back to generic regex patterns only (still catches Anthropic/Notion/Telegram tokens by shape, just no project-specific UUIDs).
_schema: Each key is a human-readable label; each value is the exact string to flag if it appears anywhere in the repo. Keys starting with underscore are ignored. Strings must be at least 6 characters or the scanner will refuse to use them (prevents accidental over-matching on short strings).
